constraints.gpt_image_2: zero reference images: strict JSON fields model,prompt and at most one of size/aspect_ratio to POST /v1/videos, then poll the original task; one to six local JPEG/PNG/WebP references: the same text fields plus ordered repeated multipart image[] file parts to POST /v1/images/edits; reject aliases, unknown fields and silent transcoding; never use /v1/images/generations, never send local paths in JSON, and never substitute or invent model names; the separate synchronous image2 contract remains unchanged
constraints.gpt_image_2_5: seven exact public model IDs and three fixed routes; n must equal one; size and aspect_ratio are mutually exclusive but may both be omitted for text-to-image; aspect_ratio must be an exact ASCII WIDTH:HEIGHT string from the model-specific allowlist, with no spaces, decimals, Unicode punctuation, aliases, or automatic normalization; image-to-image omission is allowed only when all references have one inspectable ratio, otherwise HTTP 400 size_required; the base model uses an exact size allowlist and ten aspect ratios, while K-tier models use divisible-by-16 bounded pixel dimensions and add 7:6; personal-site synchronous edits use the dedicated long-request base URL; never auto-resubmit an unknown outcome
constraints.qwen_image_3: async text-to-image and image-to-image; images accepts one to three ordered public HTTPS URLs or strict Base64 Data URIs; n remains fixed at one; Pro tier is fixed by exact model name and size cannot cross tiers
constraints.nano_banana: async only; submit with model and prompt to /v1/videos and poll the returned top-level id; optional aspect_ratio is supported; image-to-image uses one public HTTPS URL in the top-level images array; resolution is selected by exact model suffix; do not send Data URI, bare Base64, HTTP, multiple images, size, resolution, or unlisted fields
constraints.kling: async /v1/videos only; generic Chat/Responses clients are unsupported; public models are kling-v2-6, kling-3.0-turbo (fixed 720p), kling-3.0-turbo-1080p (fixed 1080p), and kling-motion-control; use seconds, never duration or resolution; preserve original IDs, HTTP status, error JSON, and billing record

image2_documentation_gate.safe_next_action: call only an exact model whose live_availability is available and call_action is allow_call
